title: whole-transcript-threshold is merged: R1008's work has landed
body:
One front-matter field and the paragraph that governs it. No code.

`docs/plans/whole-transcript-threshold.md` has carried this since it was superseded:

> It stays `status: draft` until R1008's work actually lands, at which point it becomes `status: merged` — the field's own meaning is "the work shipped, by another route", and claiming that before it has would be false.

**R1008's work landed today**, in #186, #187 and #188 — all three slices of `capped-whole-transcript-path`, covering R28 and R1008. So the condition is met and the field is flipped.

The paragraph is rewritten to say what happened rather than what will happen, and to name the three pull requests. Leaving `draft` now would be false in the other direction: the plan would keep reading as work still waiting to be done, which is exactly what the banner exists to prevent.

The DO-NOT-BUILD banner stays. The document is still kept rather than deleted, because **BL-20**, **OD-13** and **OD-19** all cite it by name.

Ran locally against this diff: `plan-resolve.sh` (exempt prefix `docs/`, cap 50), `plan-lint.sh`, `escape-refs.sh`.
